---
title: "Numeric Vectors"
---

```{r}
tibble::tribble(
  ~a, ~b,
  1, 2,
  3, 4,
  5, 6
)
```

```{r}
readr::parse_double("3.8")
# readr::parse_double("$3.8") # wrong
readr::parse_number("$3.8")
```

```{r}
x <- tibble::tibble(a = 1:100)
print(x) # print top only
print(x, n = Inf) # print all
# methods("print")
# options()
# print.default(x)
```
